quarterly_data.quarter: Microchip Technology press release: AnalogAI Selects memBrain SAGE Intellectual Property from (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Licensee AnalogAI selected the memBrain SAGE neuromorphic analog compute-in-memory IP of Microchip's Silicon Storage Technology (SST) subsidiary as the core inference engine of its first edge AI processors (aCIM performance at or below one watt, for humanoid robots, drones and vehicles). SVP Mark Reiten called AnalogAI 'the newest licensee of our SST memBrain IP, joining our rapidly expanding ecosystem.' memBrain SAGE IP is deployed in 40 nm and 28 nm foundry processes on SuperFlash, with 22 nm development on the roadmap. No licence value stated.
